# Server Rules Welcome to AFTERLIGHT! As a roleplay-focused server, we expect you to put forth effort in maintaining an immersive and realistic game environment. If you have any inquiries, please feel free to ask in Ahelp! We are happy to help!
[color=red]All AFTERLIGHT servers are strictly 18+. If we suspect that you are under this age, you will be required to supply proof of age to an admin. [bold]Refusal may result in a permanent ban.[/bold][/color]
\n[head=3][color=#ffdd47]0.0 — The Golden Rule Policy[/color][/head] \nGame admins have the final say on all rules, issues, and punishments. We reserve the right to remove you under this policy at any time if we see fit. Any admin decision that invokes this policy will be subject to high scrutiny.
\n[head=3][color=#ff3636]1.0 — Zero Tolerance Policies[/color][/head] \n[color=#e6e6e6]Rules that we provide little to no leeway for and do not tolerate.[/color]
- [textlink="1.1 — Do not attempt to evade any form of punishment. Do not ignore or abuse the ahelp system." link="Rule1.1"] - [textlink="1.2 — Do not speak in any language other than English." link="Rule1.2"] - [textlink="1.3 — Absolutely no bigotry or discrimination is permitted." link="Rule1.3"] - [textlink="1.4 — Respect other players' kink and consent settings at all times. Do not make other players uncomfortable. Respect boundaries." link="Rule1.4"] - [textlink="1.5 — Do not communicate in-round information regarding ongoing rounds to other players." link="Rule1.5"] - [textlink="1.6 — Do not intentionally use and/or abuse exploits, bugs, or external programs." link="Rule1.6"]
\n[head=3][color=#3bff72]2.0 — General Etiquette[/color][/head] \n[color=#e6e6e6]General rules and common practices. The bare-minimum guidelines that you are expected to follow.[/color]
- [textlink="2.1 — Do not be excessively disrespectful and avoid over-escalation." link="Rule2.1"] - [textlink="2.2 — Do not commit major crimes as a non-antagonist without admin approval." link="Rule2.2"] - [textlink="2.3 — Speak and behave believably like a real person." link="Rule2.3"] - [textlink="2.4 — Do not remove yourself from the round whilst facing in-character punishment or playing an important role." link="Rule2.4"] - [textlink="2.5 — Your character should be believable and realistic in-world." link="Rule2.5"]
\n[head=3][color=#59ffe1]3.0 — Roleplay Expectations[/color][/head] \n[color=#e6e6e6]Expectations centered around roleplay.[/color]
- [textlink="3.1 — Do not intentionally prepare for unrealistic situations in order to gain an advantage." link="Rule3.1"] - [textlink="3.2 — Do not excessively crowd RP situations or events." link="Rule3.2"] - [textlink="3.3 — Avoid abandoning your job without a sufficient reason." link="Rule3.3"] - [textlink="3.4 — Follow the New Life rule." link="Rule3.4"] - [textlink="3.5 — Full continuity of your character and the events that happen to them is expected." link="Rule3.5"] - [textlink="3.6 — Stay within your job or role. Retain reasonable knowledge, abilities, and skills according to your job and your characters' backstories." link="Rule3.6"] - [textlink="3.7 — Competence is expected within command and security." link="Rule3.7"] - [textlink="3.8 — Silicons should follow their laws to the best of their ability." link="Rule3.8"]
